resources.string: When you press Volume Down, or tap the screen several times quickly, takes a screenshot, sends it to Google\'s Gemini API or to DeepSeek\'s API with your own key, and taps the answer the model picks. Volume Down no longer changes the volume while this is on. Screen events (scrolling, typing, clicks) and a list of the open windows are used to tell a series of taps from normal use. When a DeepSeek model answers, the text of the app on screen (not the status bar, notifications or keyboard) is read to find the option to tap. The matching text, or, when nothing matches, all of that text, is written to this app\'s own log on the phone, which Clear deletes. Nothing is sent anywhere.
